# External: The Pudding foundation-names

Place a local copy of `allShades.csv` here if you want a convenient default path:

```text
backend/app/data/external/pudding/allShades.csv
```

Download manually from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-pudding/data/master/foundation-names/allShades.csv

Do **not** commit the full ~2MB CSV unless you intentionally choose to.
The importer accepts any `--input` path.

See `ATTRIBUTION.md`, `LICENSE`, and `backend/docs/PUDDING_IMPORT.md`.
